generation.prompt:
Create one editorial illustration for The Daily AI Pulse.
Placement: article hero. Output crop: high-resolution wide 16:9 landscape, for a centered 21:9 desktop hero, 16:9 mobile hero and 3:2 card crop. The existing story layout places this art below the introduction, not behind text.
Subject: Your First Claude API Call: From a Support Message to Typed Triage.
Verified context: We will build Northstar Helpdesk, a fictional local support assistant, starting with one request and ending with a typed triage result. Every key must exist; an unknown order uses JSON null. The schema is a well-shaped envelope; it does not certify the letter inside.
Visual idea: A folded blank paper ribbon rests partly in a fitted terracotta sorting form with one deliberately empty recess. This is an abstract physical metaphor for defined shape and visibly missing information, not a literal technical mechanism.
Candidate B, editorial: a sculptural terracotta form seen at a low three-quarter angle, with one broad curved recess occupied by the bend of a substantial folded blank cream sheet and a smaller clean empty recess beside it. An intentional offset between free paper and shaped recess creates compositional tension. Fine etched contour marks only on the material; no diagram lines.
Art direction: a restrained contemporary editorial illustration with a quiet scientific or architectural sensibility. Use deliberate geometry, fine lines, subtle paper texture, and a single clear focal idea that remains legible at thumbnail size. Harmonize with warm canvas #F3EBDD, paper #FAF6EE, near-black ink #171B1A, muted gray #575D5B and sparing terracotta #8A4B35. Spacious composition and strong contrast.
Match the inspected publication references' chalky sculptural architectural materiality, etched fine charcoal lines, restrained terracotta, lithographic paper grain, overlapping planes and controlled oblique depth. These are grammar references, not subjects to copy.
Do not produce a bare schematic, flowchart, wireframe, icon composition or minimalist architecture diagram. The central metaphor must have physical presence, subtle depth, hierarchy and material detail. Fine technical lines may support the composition but must not be the composition itself.
Keep the whole essential assembly in the central 65% of the width and central 55% of the height with generous warm paper negative space. It must survive object-fit cover on desktop/mobile and remain legible at 320px.
Depict only what verified context supports. This is an abstract editorial metaphor, never a claim of measured accuracy or guaranteed correctness.
No words, letters, numbers, labels, logos, interface elements, page header, footer, buttons, badges, charts with invented data, watermark, neon effects, robots, or generic glowing AI brains. Do not generate a headline or imitate a screenshot. No border or frame.
Deliver a clean high-resolution image, one coherent illustration, not a contact sheet. Paper must be completely blank.
Final production revision: the article now uses its verified responsive figure wrapper. Generate a new illustration against this frozen source. Preserve the requested wide negative space: all meaningful paper and terracotta elements in the central 65% width and 55% height.
